camera: Flat front-facing UI: a wide modal panel over the dimmed main game screen.

hudLayout.topThird: Dimmed header: chapter book '2', counters coin '10K', star '2K', pink meeple '6', 6-segment quest bar '0/6'; wood strip with quest scrolls left and right and centre 'UPGRADE CARDS' panel with '0/1'; khaki 'LOCAL FARM' tab with four locked tabs; terrain map strip. The modal khaki panel starts at 28%, full width with small side margins.
hudLayout.middleThird: Modal is a 3-column layout. Centre column: title 'Farm Hand' in cream bold; a large henchman card in a thick purple frame showing a boy hoisting a huge turnip over his head on a farmyard; across its middle a lime-olive button 'LEVEL UP' with '100 XP'; under the card a black pill label 'Speed x 4'; caption 'Loyal and hard working'. Left column top: darker khaki recess with title 'Throwing Carrots', a small framed gear card (bundle of carrots, white padlock), caption 'Dried and sharpened!', black pill 'Crit Bonus x 1'. Right column top: empty darker khaki recess (no card) with black pill 'Crit Luck x 1'.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Left column bottom: 'Wood Shovel' gear card (wooden shovel, padlock), caption 'Can you dig it!?!??!!!', pill 'Crit Chance x 1'. Right column bottom: 'Bucket' gear card (wooden bucket, padlock), caption 'For all the loots', pill 'Pack Size x 1'. Modal ends at 72%; below, empty dimmed navy field; walnut footer with card-deck button (red badge '1'), treasure chest with yellow '!', steel cog, 'username', debug 'fps: 60.02'.

uiStyle: Flat khaki modal with darker khaki recessed column panels, thin grey bevelled card frames, thick purple rarity frame on the henchman, lime soft-slab LEVEL UP button, black rounded stat pills with white bold text, cream caption text.
colorPalette: Warm khaki and parchment dominate, purple frame and lime button are the saturated accents; gear art in dark moody umbers; background dimmed navy.
composition: Symmetric: big centre card flanked by two stacked gear slots per side; LEVEL UP button is the focal hit.
